info.name: E7GZ PS — E7-24 venue account and Owner Password
info.description: E7-24 (with PCR-006): the admin creates a venue account; venue settings; venue photos with no Owner PIN; the venue's own Owner PIN change (4 digits); the 5-in-15-minutes lockout; admin reset, disable and enable. Needs seed-test-accounts.sql (admin postman.admin@e7gz.test) and the backend with the api and worker profiles. Each run creates its own area, venues and account, so it can be re-run (the lockout belongs to that run's account). Run from the repository root so the photo file is found.

exec: // Runs after every request (arch 09 §1.3–§1.4); signed photo links go to object storage, not our API.
pm.test("[all] X-Correlation-Id header is a UUID", () =>
pm.test("[all] Error body has a code and no message", () => {

item.name: 1 · Setup (admin creates an area and two venues)

exec: pm.test("ENABLED, for venue A, login as sent", () => { pm.expect(a.accountStatus).to.eql("ENABLED"); pm.expect(a.venueId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("venueId")); pm.expect(a.loginIdentifier).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("login")); });
pm.test("no password in the response", () => { const t = pm.response.text(); ["{{loginPassword}}", "argon2"].forEach(p => pm.expect(t).to.not.include(pm.variables.replaceIn(p))); });

item.name: 2.3 · A second account for venue A → 422 VENUE_ACCOUNT_ALREADY_EXISTS
2.4 · Venue B with A's login (other case) → 422 VENUE_LOGIN_IDENTIFIER_TAKEN
2.5 · The venue page now shows the account
3.1 · GET → the venue's own profile, language en

exec: pm.test("own venue, area name, en", () => { pm.expect(s.venueId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("venueId")); pm.expect(s.areaName).to.eql("E7-24 Area " + pm.collectionVariables.get("run")); pm.expect(s.languagePreference).to.eql("en"); pm.expect(s.marketplaceStatus).to.eql("ONBOARDING"); pm.expect(s.location.lat).to.eql(30.0561); });

item.name: 3.2 · PATCH phone only → stored as +20…, rest unchanged

exec: pm.test("phone +20, name and address unchanged", () => { pm.expect(s.phone).to.eql("+201007654321"); pm.expect(s.name).to.eql("E7-24 Lounge A"); pm.expect(s.address).to.eql("12 Abbas El Akkad St"); });

item.name: 4.2 · PUT the file to the signed link → 200
5 · The venue changes its Owner PIN (FR-VEN-46, PCR-006)
5.1 · A new PIN that is not 4 digits → 400 (field next)
5.4 · No unlock: the next change needs the PIN again (none sent) → 400
5.5 · The old PIN stops working at once → 423
6 · Lockout: 5 wrong PINs in 15 minutes (5.2, 5.5 and 6.1-6.3)
6.4 · Locked out: even the right (new) PIN → 429 RATE_LIMITED
7.1 · Reset the Owner PIN with something that is not 4 digits → 400
7.4 · Venue login with the old password → refused
7.5 · Venue login with the new password → 200
7.8 · The venue's token stops working at once → 401
